{{Quote|I was able to pinpoint several communications originating from another island. I'm told there's a Rishii village on the outskirts. I can't imagine they would resent our presence there.|C2-D4|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Sky Ridge Island''' was a mountainous island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], north of [[Horizon Island]]. Home to a [[Rishii village|village]] of the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]], the island was the site of a [[Revanite Valley Stronghold|stronghold]] established by the [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Grophet]]s, [[skar'kla]]s, [[Shaclaw|mud crabs]], and [[krak'jya]]s were among the creatures that lived in the island's numerous valleys and rivers, and it hosted deposits of the valuable ore [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]].
